title: Organization chart
description: A hierarchy of positions and units connected by reporting lines. Maps almost directly onto the ORGANIZATION dimension.

mapping.notes: a department/team/division becomes an organization record
a role/position becomes an actor and a member/role of its unit
a line becomes a reporting entry (source reports to target); dotted lines are secondary reporting

guidance: Capture every reporting line as a reporting entry (source -> target); escalation chains become escalations.
A box is both a position (actor) and a member/role of the unit that contains it.
